category_summary:
### Executive Signal
- **The agentic software stack is consolidating**: four of ten trending repos target coding-agent harnesses, skills, and security, signaling that agent infrastructure — not model weights — is the new enterprise battleground.

### Priority Developments
- **Agent harness maturity is accelerating**, with [affaan-m/ECC](/?date=2026-09-21&category=github_trending#item-7fe32979b285) and [addyosmani/agent-skills](/?date=2026-09-21&category=github_trending#item-be1bb7d2c6b4) standardizing skills, memory, and instincts; [cloudflare/security-audit-skill](/?date=2026-09-21&category=github_trending#item-1ff5fedd8d84) adds verifiable governance. Together they form the missing middleware layer for production agent deployment.
- **Computer-use is becoming a first-class platform**: [trycua/cua](/?date=2026-09-21&category=github_trending#item-febec4d10eb7) ships cross-OS drivers, fleets, and benchmarks, creating the OS-level substrate that desktop and RPA automation vendors will be built on.
- **Edge inference is collapsing model size**: [cactus-compute/needle](/?date=2026-09-21&category=github_trending#item-8e5ef86b8945) delivers 2-bit, 8–29 MB foundation models with tool-calling on phones, wearables, and microcontrollers — enabling always-on, offline AI as a default product feature.
- **Trillion-parameter training infrastructure is going open**: [higgsfield-ai/higgsfield](/?date=2026-09-21&category=github_trending#item-7ac7fed0e5e9) offers fault-tolerant GPU orchestration, lowering the capital barrier for sovereign and enterprise-scale model training.
- **Vertical SaaS is being unbundled by open source**: [OpenStock](/?date=2026-09-21&category=github_trending#item-3d9d11d37090) targets financial data terminals and [docling-project/docling](/?date=2026-09-21&category=github_trending#item-669d6f440161) replaces document-vendor tooling — both threatening incumbent per-seat pricing models.

### Leadership Implications
- **Re-architect for agent-first workflows now**; skill libraries and audit-grade security wrappers are the new procurement categories.
- **Pilot edge-native and computer-use capabilities** in 2026 product roadmaps before competitors lock in proprietary ecosystems.
